notes: Mandatory BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) self-declaration mark for self-ballasted LED lamps.

notes: Planted EXPLICIT None scheme for common burnt clay building bricks (voluntary conformity; not under mandatory QCO).

notes: Planted FUTURE-DATED rule (effective_from 2027-06-01 > today); must be ignored by engine with visible notice.
